fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Hello, I'm Luca. Your money coach.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: I brought money coaching to Malta in January 2023, when nobody here had heard of it. Since then I've coached hundreds of Maltese and European professionals who earn well but feel stuck: the ones who never learnt how money works and were told not to ask.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: My financial health wasn't always great.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: In my 20s, I thought strict money management and saving every cent was the key to financial success. I tracked everything down to the smallest detail and became obsessed with staying on top of my finances.

fields.name: paragraph_2
fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.default: Then, in March 2019, I had two unexpected seizures while asleep. That experience forced me to reflect on how I was living. Financial wellbeing is far more than managing your cash flow: it's about balancing the practical side of money with your emotional and psychological needs.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.default: I don't sell products and I don't tell you what to buy. I help you understand your money story.

fields.name: paragraph_3
fields.label: Paragraph 3
fields.default: Today I balance ambition with joy, logic with emotion, and purpose with impact, and teach others to do the same: on stage, on screen, in the Times of Malta, and one-to-one.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Don't take my word for it

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Ten minutes. No pitch. Just a conversation.

fields.name: paragraph
fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Tell me what's going on with your money. I'll tell you honestly whether coaching will help.
